extracted.intended_audience: corporate communications / PR teams, investor relations, and legal counsel preparing merger & acquisition press releases
extracted.subtask_description: Standards and checklist for drafting and distributing merger & acquisition (M&A) press releases, covering structure, mandatory content (deal, strategic, financial, governance), SEC/Form 8‑K considerations, stakeholder messaging, and a quality checklist.

rubrics_metrics.name: Headline
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Part of the standard structure; should clearly announce the transaction and include the parties or outcome in a concise, attention-getting way.

rubrics_metrics.name: Summary
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Part of the standard structure; short synopsis (one or two sentences) that encapsulates the main point of the transaction for readers and media.

rubrics_metrics.name: Lead
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Part of the standard structure; opening paragraph that must address core facts (who/what/when/why) and draw readers into the body.

rubrics_metrics.name: Body
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Part of the standard structure; expands on deal specifics, strategic rationale, financial details, governance, and stakeholder impact with necessary context and quotes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Quotes
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Part of the standard structure; typically includes CEO quotes from one or both companies to provide tone, strategic framing and senior-level perspective.

rubrics_metrics.name: Boilerplate
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Part of the standard structure; standard company descriptions for acquirer and target (size, business summary, geography) used for context and consistent messaging.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contact information
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Part of the standard structure; media and investor contacts with names, phone numbers, and emails; required for follow-up and regulatory filing exhibits.

rubrics_metrics.name: Lead paragraph must address WHO/WHAT/WHEN/WHY
rubrics_metrics.description: WHO is involved (acquirer + target); WHAT the transaction is (merger, acquisition, joint venture); WHEN it occurs (or expected close date); WHY it matters to the market
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The lead should succinctly answer these four questions so that the essential news is immediately clear to readers, investors, and media.

rubrics_metrics.name: Deal type and structure
rubrics_metrics.description: Deal type and structure (merger vs acquisition)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: State whether it's a merger, acquisition, asset purchase, stock purchase, joint venture, etc., and describe the high-level legal/structural form of the transaction.

rubrics_metrics.name: Purchase price (if disclosed)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include the headline consideration amount when allowed; if undisclosed, explain that it is undisclosed and provide high-level context where appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Form of consideration
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specify whether consideration is cash, stock, assumed debt, or a mix; clarify conversion ratios or exchange mechanics when relevant.

rubrics_metrics.name: Expected accretion/dilution
rubrics_metrics.guidance: State whether the transaction is expected to be accretive or dilutive to EPS (or other metrics) and any timing assumptions behind that expectation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Expected synergies
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Summarize anticipated cost savings, revenue synergies, or operational efficiencies and, if appropriate, expected timing to realization.

rubrics_metrics.name: Expected close date
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide an expected or target close date, or a timeline for completion, including any known milestone dates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Conditions to close
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List material conditions precedent (regulatory approvals, financing, third-party consents) that must be satisfied before closing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Approvals required
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specify which approvals are required (e.g., antitrust/regulatory, board and/or shareholder approvals) and any expected timelines or processes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Strategic fit
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explain how the target complements the acquirer’s strategy — capabilities, market share, product lines, or technology that justify the deal.

rubrics_metrics.name: Combined company description
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe the merged entity’s profile (scale, combined revenue/employees/geographic reach) to help stakeholders understand the new enterprise.

rubrics_metrics.name: Market position
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explain how the transaction affects competitive positioning, market share, or leadership in relevant segments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Customer impact
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Address how customers will be affected — continuity of service, product roadmaps, benefits from combined offerings, and reassurance language as needed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Geographic expansion
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note any expansion into new regions or strengthening of presence in key markets as a rationale or outcome of the deal.

rubrics_metrics.name: Product/technology synergies
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe complementary products, platforms, IP, or R&D advantages that create strategic value post-transaction.

rubrics_metrics.name: Revenue/EBITDA impact
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Summarize expected effects on key financial metrics such as revenue and EBITDA, including direction and magnitude if available.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pro forma financials
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide pro forma revenue, EBITDA or other financial metrics when appropriate to illustrate combined company scale and financials.

rubrics_metrics.name: Multiple paid (if disclosed)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: State valuation multiples (e.g., EV/EBITDA) if the parties choose to disclose them to give market context for the price.

rubrics_metrics.name: Financing details
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explain how the transaction is being financed (cash on hand, debt financing, equity issuance, committed financing sources).

rubrics_metrics.name: Advisor fees (rare)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note whether advisor financial terms or fees are disclosed — typically uncommon, but sometimes included for transparency.

rubrics_metrics.name: Board representation
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Detail any agreed changes to board seats, observer rights, or governance arrangements as part of the transaction.

rubrics_metrics.name: Management changes
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Announce expected management appointments, departures, or reporting structures post-close where determined and appropriate to disclose.

rubrics_metrics.name: Headquarters
rubrics_metrics.guidance: State the planned headquarters or any relocation/retention decisions affecting corporate domicile or major offices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Brand strategy
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Address whether brands will be maintained, integrated, or retired and how customers should expect brand-related changes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Form 8‑K filing requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Form 8-K Filing: Required if material to acquirer; Filed within 4 business days; Press release often filed as exhibit
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If the acquisition is material to a U.S. public acquirer, a Form 8‑K is required and typically must be filed within four business days; the press release is often attached as an exhibit to the filing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Forward‑looking statements safe harbor
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include standard forward-looking statements language (safe harbor) when the release contains projections, expectations, or other forward-looking information to limit liability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cautionary language
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Add appropriate cautionary statements about risks, uncertainties, and assumptions underlying forward-looking statements and projections.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tender offer / proxy statement references
rubrics_metrics.description: Tender offer / proxy statement references (where applicable)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When the transaction involves a tender offer or requires shareholder votes, reference forthcoming solicitation documents, filings, or proxy statements.

rubrics_metrics.name: "Additional information" notice
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Advise readers where they can find more detailed materials (investor presentations, SEC filings, transaction FAQs) and point to contact channels.

rubrics_metrics.name: Customer reassurance
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explicitly reassure customers about continuity, service levels, product support, and any changes they should expect as a result of the transaction.

rubrics_metrics.name: Employee impact
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Address likely effects on employees where possible (retention plans, redundancies, integration timelines) while balancing confidentiality and HR processes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Supplier impact
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note expected impacts on suppliers or supply chains where material to operations or continuity of service.

rubrics_metrics.name: Competitive landscape
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Situate the transaction within the competitive context — how it affects competitors and the company's relative positioning.

rubrics_metrics.name: Deal terms clear (or appropriately vague if undisclosed)
rubrics_metrics.description: Deal terms clear (or appropriately vague if undisclosed)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure deal mechanics are presented transparently; where parties cannot disclose specifics, use clear language to explain that terms are confidential.

rubrics_metrics.name: Strategic rationale articulated
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Clearly explain why the transaction is being done and what strategic objectives it serves for the parties involved.

rubrics_metrics.name: CEO quotes from both companies
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include senior-executive quotes (typically CEOs) from one or both parties to add authority, tone, and strategic framing to the announcement.

rubrics_metrics.name: SEC compliance language
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include any required SEC-related disclosures or references (filings, exhibits) and ensure statements align with required public disclosures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Forward‑looking safe harbor
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Duplicate emphasis on including safe harbor language for projections and expectations to mitigate forward-looking risk.

rubrics_metrics.name: Approval/closing conditions stated
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Make explicit what approvals and closing conditions exist so stakeholders understand contingencies and timelines.

rubrics_metrics.name: Combined company facts (revenue, employees, geography)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide concrete facts about the combined business footprint and scale to give readers a sense of the transaction's magnitude.

rubrics_metrics.name: Customer/employee impact addressed
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure the release speaks to both customer and employee concerns, even if only to promise more detail in subsequent communications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Conference call/investor materials referenced
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reference planned investor calls, presentations, or supplemental materials and provide timing and access details.

rubrics_metrics.name: Legal counsel + management review
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Confirm that legal counsel and senior management have reviewed the release for accuracy and compliance prior to distribution.

rubrics_metrics.name: Coordinated with both PR teams
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure messaging is coordinated and approved by both companies’ communications teams to avoid mixed messages or leaks.

rubrics_metrics.name: Embargo discipline
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Maintain strict embargo control when necessary (e.g., pre-announcement media outreach) to manage timing and simultaneous disclosure.

rubrics_metrics.name: Distribution via Reg FD wire
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Distribute material news via a Reg FD-compliant wire service to meet fair disclosure obligations for public companies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ticker symbols included
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include stock ticker symbols for public companies involved so investors can quickly identify the equities affected.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tender offer specifics (where applicable)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When relevant, include details about tender offer mechanics, timelines, and participant instructions or point readers to formal solicitation materials.
